newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buys 36,000T of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buys 36,000T of Chinese corn.

text.p: South Korean feed mill companies bought 36,000 tonnes of Chinese corn from Toepfer through private negotiations, officials with the companies said on Friday.
They said the companies included Cheiljedang Corp, Miwon Co Ltd, Woo Sung Feed Mill Co Ltd and Purina Korea Inc.
The officials said arrival of one 12,000-tonne shipment was slated by April 20, the next 12,000 tonnes by April 30 and the last 12,000 tonnes by May 10 to the western port city of Kunsan.
